notes.note: Reid took a bit to get going but he fired up before getting the tag from Jordon in the last term and was held to just 10 points in that quarter. He did have 28 disposals at 85%.
Reid has been on a good run of scoring recently and shows no sign of slowing down. 19 disposals for him with his 8 contested possessions.
Reid continues to show he is a great option in your forward line with his 28 disposals this week.
Reid is putting together a fantastic second season with his 27 disposals this week and he was one of just three Dockers over 100 this week. His first back to back weeks over 100 this year.
Reid has now had two over 120 in the last three but that other score was a concern. He looked good with his 23 disposals yielding 2 goals.
A very quiet second term from Reid as he finished with 21 disposals. This was his lowest score since round 3.

30 disposals and 9 contested possessions for Reid as he was one of the ones that got the Dockers up and running in the last quarter. This was just his second score over 100 for the season and he equal top scored in this game.
A late goal for Reid went with his 30 disposals but the efficiency was down in the wet at 63%.

1.2 for Reid from his 20 disposals. He was one of the catalysts in that last term that helped get the win for the Dockers. His scoring is hanging around the 70s and 80s which makes him almost a keeper.
Reid's scoring has plateaued lately with a couple of scores in the70s in a row. If you got him for cash generation he has topped out at the moment and with Young back he has less CBAs.
Reid hasn't had the big scores this season but he is still scoring well however this was his lowest in the last four games.
Reid had his second best score of the season so far from his 26 disposals. He remains a good forward option.
Reid is showing his value to this Docker side with 22 disposals in the wet. Just the efficiency hurt him in this game like most players in the game.
Reid is an impressive young player and had 26 disposals and 5 tackles. He is one you can consider but he will be a must have in years to come.
Reid was quiet this week and really dropped down from his first two scores. He saw plenty of the footy with 23 touches but his usage included 8 clangers.
Reid was the third best scorer for the Dockers as he was talked about a lot this year. He had 41% CBAs and looks to have a great role.
